about: The reduced-motion opening (Ingram, 2026-09-26): the same song and pictures as opening.json, with far fewer cuts, half the movement at half the speed or less (always the middle of each move), a dissolve at every cut and nothing that flashes. Players choose it or the full opening when the GM plays it. Built from opening.json at render time (tools/title-sequence/titleseq/reduced.py), so every picture swapped into the full opening appears here too. Never synced to the Foundry server, like opening.json.

segments.note: The black leader and the ripple, played as they are. Ingram (2026-09-26): the ripple is not strong enough to cause any issues, and the intro isn't as nice without it.
Held through the burst and the smoke strobe, which are left out.
The wordmark card, held through the flashing blue reveal.
The logo, without its flares, its bursting orb or the X beams to white.
The verse, slowed.
The sunset and the blueprint.
Taka in front of the school.
The Watcher, without the tape tearing.
The stencil card.
The counters. The control panel that follows them (its tabs flash white as they release) is left out.
The middle of the mech bay's pan.
Section Officer Vetch, the middle of his slow push in.
The four founders, two of them (R28 and R30) each held twice as long, so no cut comes sooner than 0.7 s.

The machinery pan (Ingram's tech-pan-01), in place of the quick close-ups and the core's flash.

The domed assembly hall.

FIRST IMPACT.
The stately house.
The Gen 2 walker on the hill with the radar scope over it: the middle of bar 37's pan, slowed. The HERE card before it is left out.
The Gen 2 pilot's tilt, a bar of it: a glimpse (LEDGER #37).
The vault door, pushing in slowly under the director's credit, without the stripe's wipe, as far as its first seam of light.
The young soldier in the witch's hat watching the evening, holding the group shot's place, without the lens flare.
The end card, as it is: still, its credit fading in, then out to black.
